newsitem.title: CANADA: Reuters Canada launches online service.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Canada launches online service.

text.p: Reuters Information Services (Canada) Ltd, a unit of Reuters Holdings Plc, said on Wednesday it launched Reuters Online Canada, an Internet service for news, sports, business and entertainment information.

Reuters said "The ROC," a seven-day-a-week, 24-hour multimedia service delivering online news, feature and photo packages, was now available to Canadian web publishers, corporate sites and corporate Intranets.
News packages consisting of 10 stories are updated through the day to give readers an instant view of what is happening in Canada and the rest of the world, Reuters said.
The ROC also offers a five-day-a-week report in French that includes news, business and sports to fulfill demand by the growing number of French speakers online in Canada.
"We think The ROC will anchor any Web site. It will be comprehensive aent in the way only Reuters can deliver," Reuters Online Canada Editor Russell Blinch said in a statement.

Reuters said one of the most unique aspects of The ROC was the weekly Life package, consisting of columns featuring stories on health and people. Life's three columns include "Roughing It", about sporting in the wilds of Canada, "Lifeline", a people-oriented essay, and "Plugged In", a sometimes off-the-wall report from a seasoned Internet surfer.

Canada's largest Internet service, Sympatico, will be the first Canadian Internet service provider to carry the English and French ROC packages. Both versions will be accessible from the Sympatico Web site at www.sympatico.ca -- in French on the InfoExpress site and in English on NewsExpress.
"If you have a Web site -- be it something for the public on the Internet or on your company's private Intranet -- then you should be talking to Reuters," Reuters Canada President Ken Troy said.
"The ROC is just the latest in a range of Reuters Online products backed by its strong editorial presence in Canada and around the world," he added.
In addition to Reuters Online Canada Service, Reuters offers a number of Internet and/or Intranet solutions.
